title: Fred Warner felt the Rams "withered away" as game went on

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Fred Warner felt the Rams "withered away" as game went on
sources.description: The Rams took a 7-3 lead over the 49ers on the first play of the second quarter on Thursday night, but it was not a sign that things were going to go their way for the rest of their time in Melbourne, Australia.
